Yoruba: Àrùn Covid-19 tí a kọ́kọ́ jábọ̀ ni oṣù Ọpẹ́ ọdún 2019, àti ní oṣù Opẹ́ ọdún 2020, Wọ́n sì tún fún àwọn èèyàn ní abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára ti àkọ́kọ́.
Zulu: Isifo se-Covid-19 saqala ukubikwa ngoZibandlela wezi-2019, kusenjalo ngawo uZibandlela wezi-2020, umgomo wokuqala wawusulungele ukuthi unikezwe abantu.
Hausa: An fara ba da rahoton cutar ta Covid-19 a cikin Disamba 2019, kuma tuni ya zuwa Disamba 2020, an shirya rigakafin farko da za a ba mutane.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bja Covid-19 bo begilwe la mathomo ka Desemere 2019, gomme ka Desemere 2020, meento ya mathomo e be e šetše e lokile go ka entelwa batho.
Amharic: የኮቪድ-19 በሽታ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተዘገበው በዲሴምበር 2019 ሲሆን በዲሴምበር 2020 የመጀመሪያዎቹ ክትባቶች ለሰዎች ለመከፋፈል ዝግጁ ሆነው ነበር፡፡

Source: How a community will accept a rapidly-produced vaccine is often affected by how they perceive the disease and the vaccine itself.
Luganda: Engeri abantu gye banakkirizaamu eddagala erigema erikoleddwa ku mbiro etera okukosebwa engeri gye batwalamu endwadde n’eddagala erigema lyennyini.
Yoruba: À ti bí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára yìí náà ṣe má di ìtẹ́wọ́gbà lọ́dọ̀ àwọn èèyàn inú àjọ nííṣe pẹ̀lú ojú tí wón fi sí àrùn àti abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára náà lára.
Zulu: Indlela umphakathi ozokwamukela ngayo umgomo okhiqizwe ngokushesha uzolawulwa indlela abasibona ngaso isifo nanawo umgomo uqobo.
Hausa: Yadda al'umma za su yarda da rigakafin da ake samarwa cikin sauri yana shafar yadda suke gane cutar da kuma maganin kanta.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao setšhaba se tlago amogela meento ye e tšweleditšwego ka lebelo gantši go angwa ke ka fao ba nago le maikutlo ka ga bolwetši le ka ga moento ka bowona.
Amharic: አንድ ማህበረሰብ በፍጥነት የሚመረተውን ክትባት መቀበል አለመቀበሉ ላይ ተጽእኖ የሚያደርገው ለበሽታው እና ለክትባቱ ያለው አመለካከት ነው፡፡

Source: In this study, the researchers wanted to know how Kenyans specifically think about the disease and being vaccinated against it.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya engeri Bannakenya gye balowooza ku ndwadde awamu n’okugemebwa eri endwadde eyo.
Yoruba: Nínú ìṣe ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ mọ bí àwọn ọmọ orílẹ̀-ède Kenya ṣe dìídì ṣe máa ń ronú nípa àrùn náà àti bí wọ́n ṣe lòdì sí gbígba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi abantu base Kenya bacabangani ngalesisifo nanokugomela sona.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so sanin yadda 'yan Kenya ke tunani musamman game da cutar da kuma yin rigakafinta.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba nyakile go tseba ka fao badudi ba Kenya ba naganago ka ga bolwetši bjo le go entelwa kgahlanong le bjona.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ ኬንያውያን ስለ በሽታው እና የመከላከያውን ክትባት ስለመውሰድ ምን እንደሚያስቡ ለይተው ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: They did an online survey of adults above 18 years in Kenya, using WhatsApp, emails and Facebook during January and February 2021.
Luganda: Baakola okunoonyereza okw’oku mutimbagano ku bantu abakulu abasussa emyaka 18 mu Kenya, nga bakozesa WhatsApp, emails ne Facebook mu Gwolubereberye n’Ogwokubiri gw’omwaka gwa 2021.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí orí afẹ́fẹ́ fún àwọn àgbàlagbà tí wọ́n ju ọmọ ọdún 18 lọ ní Kenya nípa lílo èrò Whatsapp, ẹ̀rọ ímeelì àti èrò Facebook ní oṣù Ṣẹẹrẹ àti oṣù Èrèlé ọdún 2021.
Zulu: Benza ucwaningo ngendlela yemiqhafazo (online) lwabantu base Kenya abaneminyaka engaphezulu kwe-18, besebenzisa u-WhatsApp, emails, kanye no-Facebook ngoMasingana kanye noNhlolanja wezi-2021.
Hausa: Sun yi wani binciken kan layi akan manya sama da shekaru 18 a Kenya, ta amfani da WhatsApp, imel da Facebook a cikin Janairu da Fabrairu 2021.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile dinyakišišo tša inthaneteng ka ga batho ba bagolo ba mengwaga ya ka godimo ga ye 18 ka Kenya, ba šomiša WhatsApp, diemeile le Facebook ka Janerware le ka Feberware 2021.
Amharic: በጃንዋሪ እና ፌብርዋሪ 2021 ጊዜ ዋትስአፕ፣ኢሜይሎች እና ፌስቡክን በመጠቀም በኬንያ ከ18 አመት በላይ በሆኑ ጎልማሶች ላይ የመስመር ላይ የዳሰሳ ጥናት አድርገዋል፡፡

Source: Researchers asked questions on personal details and on perceptions of Covid-19, and people’s willingness to take a Covid-19 vaccine.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baabuuza ebibuuzo ku bikwata ku muntu ssekinnoomu ne ku ntwala za Covid-19, awamu n’obwetegefu bw’abantu okugenda bagemebwe eddagala lya Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí bèrè àwọn ìbéèrè lórí àlàyé lẹ́kunrẹ́rẹ́ nípa ara ẹni àti lórí ojú àmúwayé nípa Covid-19 àti bí àwọn ènìyàn ṣe ṣetán láti gba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára Covid-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babuza imibuzo ngemininingwane yomuntu siqu, nanemibono nge-Covid-19, nangendlela abantu abafisa ngayo ukuthatha umgomo we-Covid-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi tambayoyi kan bayanan sirri da kuma fahimtar Covid-19, da kuma niyyar mutane don ɗaukar rigakafin Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba botšišitše dipotšišo ka ga dintlha tša sephiri le ka ga maikutlo mabapi le Covid-19, le go nyaka ga batho go hlabelwa ka moento wa Covid-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ግላዊ መረጃዎችን እና፣ስለ ኮቪድ-19 ግንዛቤዎች፣እንዲሁም የኮቪድ-19ን ክትባት በመውሰድ ላይ የሰዎችን ፍቃደኝነት ጠይቀዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers then used statistical tests to assess the relationship between perceptions and willingness to take vaccine.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza oluvannyuma baakozesa ebibalo okusobola okwekaliriza enkolagana wakati w’entwala n’obwetegefu bw’okufuna eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí máa ń lo ìṣirò onídánwò láti fi wo ibasepo láàárín ìwòye àti bí èèyàn ṣe ṣetán láti gba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babe sebesebenzisa ukuhlola kwezibalo ukubona ubudlelwano phakathi kwemibono nendlela abafisa ngayo ukuthatha umgomo.
Hausa: Daga nan ne masu binciken suka yi amfani da gwaje-gwajen kididdiga don tantance alakar da ke tsakanin hasashe da kuma niyyar daukar rigakafin.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao banyakišiši ba šomišitše diteko tša dipalopalo go sekaseka kamano magareng ga maikutlo le go nyaka go entelwa ka moento.
Amharic: ከዛ ተመራማሪዎቹ በግንዛቤ እና ክትባት ለመውሰድ ባለ ፍቃደኝነት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለመገምገም ስታትስቲካዊ ሙከራዎችን ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

Source: Their results showed that 68% of participants agreed that Covid-19 was present in Kenya, and 75% were willing to take the vaccine if given to them.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byalaga nti ebitundu 68% eby’abeetabi bakkiriza nti Covid-19 yaliwo mu Kenya, era ng’ebitundu 75% baali beetegefu okufuna eddagala erigema singa libaweebwa.
Yoruba: Èsì wọn fi hàn pé 68% àwọn olùkópa ni wọ́n gbà pé àrùn Covid-19 wà ní Kenya, àti pé 75% ni wọ́n sì ṣetàn pé wọ́n ma gba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára tí wọ́n bá fún wọn.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo yaveza ukuthi-68% walabo ababayinxenye bavuma ukuthi i-Covid-19 ibikhona eKenya, futhi u-75% ubuzimisele ukuthatha umgomo uma babenikezwa.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa kashi 68% na mahalarta taron sun yarda cewa Covid-19 na nan a Kenya, kuma kashi 75% na son daukar maganin idan aka ba su.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše gore 68% ya bakgathatema ba dumetše gore Covid-19 e be e le gona ka Kenya, gomme 75% e be e nyaka go entelwa ge ba ka fiwa sebaka.
Amharic: ውጤታቸው 68% ተሳታፊዎች ኮቪድ-19 በኬንያ እንዳለ መስማማታቸውን እና፣75%  የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ክትባቱ ከተሰጣቸው ለመቀበል ዝግጁ እንደሆኑ አሳይቷል፡፡

Source: More females agreed that Covid-19 was real and were willing to be vaccinated compared to men.
Luganda: Abakyala bangi bakkiriza nti Covid-19 yali wa ddala era nga baali beetegefu okugemebwa okusinga abasajja.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn obìnrin gbà pé àrùn Covid-19 wà lóòótọ́ bẹẹ̀ wọ́n sì ṣetán láti gba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára yàtọ̀ sí àwọn ọkùnrin.
Zulu: Abesifazane abaningi bavuma ukuthi i-Covid-19 ibikhona ngampela futhi babezimisele ukugoma uma beqhathaniswa nabesilisa.
Hausa: Yawancin mata sun yarda cewa Covid-19 na gaske ne kuma suna shirye a yi musu allurar idan aka kwatanta da maza.
Northern Sotho: Basadi ba bantši ba dumetše gore Covid-19 e gona ebile ba be ba nyaka go entelwa ge go bapetšwa le banna.
Amharic: አብዛኞቹ ሴቶች ኮቪድ-19 እውን እንደሆነ ተስማምተዋል እንዲሁም ለመከተብ ከወንዶች ይልቅ ፈቃደኞች ሆነዋል፡፡

Source: Their results also showed that more employed participants were willing to be vaccinated compared to those unemployed.
Luganda: Bye baazuula era byalaga nti abeetabi abalina emirimu bangi baali beetegefu okugemebwa bw’ogeraageranya n’abo abatalina mirimu.
Yoruba: Èsì wọn fi hàn pé ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn tó ní iṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ ṣetán láti gba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára yàtọ̀ sí àwọn wọn kò ní iṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo yaveza ukuthi iningi labasebenzayo ababeyinxenye babezimisele ukugoma uma kuqhathaniswa nabangasebenzi.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya kuma nuna cewa, ƙarin mahalarta aikin sun yarda a yi musu allurar idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda ba su da aikin yi.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše gore bakgathatema ba bantši bao ba šomago ba be ba nyaka go entelwa ge go bapetšwa le bao ba sa šomego.
Amharic: ውጤታቸው እንደሚያሳየው ከስራ አጦች ይልቅ ብዙ ተቀጣሪ ተሳታፊዎች ለመከተብ ፈቃደኞች ነበሩ፡፡

Source: Participants in rural Kenya were more willing to take the vaccine when compared to those in urban areas, even though people in rural areas were not as aware that Covid-19 existed.
Luganda: Abeetabi okuva mu bitundu by’e Kenya eby’omu byalo baali beetegefu nnyo okufuna eddagala erigema bw’ogeraageranya n’abo ababeera mu bitundu ebisangibwa mu kibuga, wadde ng’abantu mu byalo okumanya kwabwe ku kubaawo kwa Covid-19 kwali kutono.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùkọ́pa ní ìgbèríko ní Kenya ṣetán láti gba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára yàtọ̀ sí àwọn tí wọ́n gbé ní àárín ìlú, kódà àwọn tí wọ́n wà ní ìgbèríko kò mọ̀ pé Covid-19 wà.
Zulu: Abasemaphandleni ase Kenya ababeyinxenye babezimisele kakhulu ukuthatha umgomo uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abasezi ndaweni zasemadolobheni, ngisho noma abantu basemakhaya babengazi ukuthi i-Covid-19 ikhona.
Hausa: Mahalarta a yankunan karkarar Kenya sun fi son shan maganin idan aka kwatanta da na birane, duk da cewa mutanen karkara ba su san cewa akwai Covid-19 ba.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema ba ka dinagamagaeng tša ka Kenya ba be ba sa nyake go entelwa ge ba bapetšwa le bao ba dulago ka metsesetoropong, le ge e le gore batho bao ba dulago ka dinagamagaeng ba be ba s alemoge gore Covid-19 e gona.
Amharic: ከገጠሪቷ ኬንያ የመጡ ተሳታፊዎች ምንም እንኳ ኮቪድ-19 እውን መሆኑን ያን ያህል ባይረዱም፣ በከተማ ከሚኖሩት ጋር ሲነጻጸር ክትባቱን ለመውሰድ የበለጠ ፍቃደኞች ነበሩ፡፡

Source: Despite this, the researchers also reported that 61% of participants had no confidence in the government or the vaccine.
Luganda: Newankubadde nga kiri kiti, abanoonyereza era baagamba nti abeetabi ebitundu 61% baali tebalina kukkiririza mu gavumenti wadde eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Ní adúrú gbogbo eléyìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí jábọ̀ pé 61% àwọn olùkọ́pá kò ní ìgboyà nínú ìjọba tàbí nínú abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára.
Zulu: Ngaphandle kwalokhu, abacwaningi baphinde babika ukuthi u-61% walabo ababeyinxenye babengenakho ukumthemba uhulumeni noma umgomo.
Hausa: Duk da wannan, masu binciken sun kuma bayar da rahoton cewa kashi 61% na mahalarta ba su da kwarin gwiwa ga gwamnati ko allurar.
Northern Sotho: Ka ntle le se, banyakišiši ba begile gape gore 61% ya bakgathatema ba be ba se na tshepo go mmušo goba go moento.
Amharic: ይህም ሆኖ ተመራማሪዎቹ 61% ያህሉ ተሳታፊዎች በመንግስት እና በክትባቱ ላይ ምንም እምነት እንደሌላቸውም ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers said their findings suggest the health ministry needed to build the confidence of the Kenyan population in the vaccine.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bye baazuula biraga nti ekitongole ky’ebyobulamu kyalina okuzimba okukkiriza mu bantu b’omu Kenya eri eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣewádìí náà sọ pé ìwádìí fi hàn pé mínísítírì tí ó ń rí sí ọ̀rọ̀ ètò ìlera nílò láti fún àwọn ọmọ orílẹ̀-ède Kenya ní ìgboyà lórí abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹ́sára.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi abakutholile kusho ukuthi ungqongqoshe wezempilo ebedinga ukwakha ukuthi bawuthembe umgomo abantu base Kenya.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon binciken nasu ya nuna cewa akwai bukatar ma'aikatar lafiya ta karfafa kwarin gwiwar al'ummar Kenya kan allurar.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dikutollo tša bona di šišinya gore kgoro ya maphelo e swanetše go moento ka setšhabeng sa Kenya.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በግኝቶቻቸው የኬንያ የጤና ሚኒስቴር ህዝቡ በክትባቱ ላይ ያለውን እምነት ማሳደግ እንዳለበት ይናገራሉ፡፡

Source: They cautioned however that their survey was limited to people with access to smartphones, computers and internet access, hence they got many responses from urban areas.
Luganda: Wabula baalabula nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kwakolebwa ku bantu bokka abaalina amasimu ag’okuseereza, kompyuta ne yintaneeti, ne kiba nga baafuna okuddibwamu kungi okuva mu bitundu ebiri mu kibuga.
Yoruba: Nítorí ìdí èyí ni wọ́n fi kìlọ̀ fún wọn pé ìwádìí yìí wà fún àwọn tí wọ́n lo fóònù alágbéká, Kọ̀mpútà àti lilo ẹ̀rọ alátagbà, bẹ́ẹ̀ wọ́n rí ìdáhùn láti ọ̀dọ̀ tí wọ́n gbé ní àárín ìlú.
